newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: KLM Kenya Airways eye more cargo.
newsitem.headline: KLM Kenya Airways eye more cargo.

text.p: The cargo divisions of KLM Royal Dutch Airlines and Kenya Airways are talking about possible future areas of co-operation, a KLM spokesman told Reuters.
He said the two airlines are investigating co-operating in postal airfreight and diplomatic freight.
In 1996 KLM bought a 26 pct stake in Kenya Airways saying that the acquisition would be initially passenger orientated.

Both airlines are currently making use of each others' freight capacity on flights between Amsterdam and Nairobi, while the talks are also focusing on the prospects of using Nairobi as a hub location for future joint freight-based operations. --Reuters Air Cargo Newsroom Tel+44-171-542-7706 Fax+5017
